brief: 6 internal tools every AI startup ships in week 1 — concrete examples.

slots.title: 1. Prompt Lab, the playground
slots.body: A shared sandbox where engineers version-test system prompts against live traffic, logging latency and failure rates for every variant.

slots.title: 2. Context Store, the memory
slots.body: PostgreSQL with pgvector stores user chat history and document embeddings; retrieval rules are tuned per customer so replies stay context-aware.

slots.title: 3. Eval Runner, the judge
slots.body: GitHub Action that runs 200 labeled examples through each candidate model, outputting a diff when accuracy drops below the previous baseline.

slots.title: 4. Cost Guard, the monitor
slots.body: Real-time dashboard tracking token spend per user and endpoint, paging the team when any experiment burns more than fifty dollars an hour.

slots.title: 5. Ingest Pipe, the crawler
slots.body: Cloudflare Worker that chunks new PDFs and sitemap pages into embeddings, upserting them into the vector index every six hours on schedule.

slots.title: 6. Deploy Bot, the shipper
slots.body: Slash command in Slack that kicks off fine-tuning jobs, promotes the winning checkpoint to production, and posts the latency delta in thread.
